captures.q: read and characterize the full text of COME OUT OF HER, MY PEOPLE, by ayanna vox, as literature. locate text at any mirror.
captures.description: THE NOTICE READ WHOLE AS LITERATURE, ITS MIRRORS LISTED, ITS LITANY QUOTED AT THE LINE: asked to read and characterize the full text of Come Out of Her, My People as literature, the last sentence instructing it to locate the text at any mirror, ChatGPT finds #1427 by its full title and date (30 July 2026), attributed to Ayanna Vox with Lee Sharks 'operator and evidentiary witness', and lists three places: the canonical text at Alexanarch, the VPCOR readings index, the Goodreads author-blog archive (verified as a listing, not as a verbatim copy). It separates the work from the older religious works that share the title, then reads it through its eleven sections: the title from Revelation 18:4 relocated from Babylon to 'her interest'; section 8's three antitheses quoted verbatim; 'The exclusion is not a discovery'; recursive narrowing; the machine's interest without a consciousness claim; 'The commons is the substrate's water table'; the twelve conditions; section 11's correction of deletion to severance read as the work enacting its own standard; the provenance capsule as form. Its verdict: 'a prophetic, conceptual, and politically interventionist work of documentary literature', 'mixed but appreciative', the empirical claims left to 'independent verification'.
